{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive ( > 0.5), pull forecasts toward mean-reversion to avoid overshooting current prices",
    "Negative sentiment ( < 0.33) requires faster mean reversion to depressed levels since prices can't go below zero",
    "Adjust forecast curvature based on price volatility - flatten when volatility is high to avoid lag",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative requires faster deceleration in forecasts than the reverse transition",
    "When price is near historical lows, forecasts need more aggressive mean reversion than model predicts",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when price has been flat (less volatility) over the last 7 days",
    "Correct systematic forecast overshoot by scaling distances from mean by sentiment-adjusted volatility"
] }
